searchText: Isn't the `engine_` namespace priviledged? I thought `engine_` was how the EL and CL communicated with each other, and it was a strongly trusted communication channel (unlike the current JSON-RPC which is often exposed publicly). Hello, do anyone know how the payload hash is computed? is it the hash of the RLP of ONLY the payload fields, or does it also include mixDigest, 0-encoded Difficulty and 0-encoded transactionRoot also is transactionRoot used after the merge
